verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You gave it all for me
My soul desire
My everything
All I am is devoted to You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
How could I fail to see
You are the love that rescued me
And all I am is devoted to You

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
And oh, how could I not be moved
Lord here with You
So have Your way in me
Cause Lord there is just one thing
And that I will seek

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
This is my cry
My one desire
Just to be where You are Lord
Now and forever

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
It's more than a song
My one desire
Is to be with You
Is to be with You
Jesus

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
The one thing
The one thing I ask
Is to be with You
